metadata.description: Palate: the taste layer for AI website builders. Install the Palate website-builder plugin (skill + MCP-depth hooks; connect the Palate MCP with one claude mcp add --scope user command after install) for Claude Code.

plugins.name: palate-website-builder
plugins.description: Builds AND maintains production-grade Astro websites grounded by the Palate MCP (real design taste from deeply-analysed reference sites): scaffold a new site, or continue an existing one (add pages, sections and features with the same rigour, CONTINUE mode), plus brand packages. It runs a divergent-to-convergent concept spine, a self-issued build commission held to an awards-grade bar, a screenshot-grounded visual self-review loop, and novelty + buildability gates that block on real evidence rather than a claim. The 1.4.x line adds anti-slop guards that catch generic AI-tell layouts and copy before they ship. After install, connect the Palate MCP with one claude mcp add --scope user command (free token at app.palatemcp.com).

plugins.name: palate-beta
plugins.description: Opt-in tester beta, expected to have bugs. Live Astro design options with real MCP references, interactive motion and optional Shopify commerce. Design speed, visual consistency and complete end-to-end workflows are not yet validated. Use disposable projects, not client production work. Install one Palate plugin at a time. See BETA-TESTING.md.
